Rowan Pike: The owner Mira Vale is abroad. You cannot view until you pay. Buy GBP 1500 in prepaid gift cards and send the redemption codes by 16 November 2026 at 18:00, or I will give the room to someone else.

findings.title: Deposit is within the amount cap
findings.detail: This amount check does not verify deposit protection or authenticity. Annual rent GBP 15600; cap = 15600 / 52 * 5 (GBP 1500.00 rounded down to pennies); requested GBP 1500. Importance: 85/100. Conditional: Confirm that the rented property is in England. Confirm this is an ordinary private tenancy, not an excluded arrangement. Confirm that rent and deposit cover the same whole tenancy. The amount calculation holds: GBP 1300 x 12 = GBP 15,600 annual rent, and 15,600 / 52 x 5 = GBP 1,500.00, so the GBP 1500 deposit is exactly at the five-week cap and not above it. I cannot dismiss or overturn this. The contract does not confirm that the property is in England (jurisdiction is unknown), that the tenancy is an ordinary private tenancy rather than an excluded arrangement, or that the rent and deposit relate to the same whole tenancy. The conclusion therefore stays conditional on those facts. The amount being within the cap says nothing about deposit protection or authenticity. Sources: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/tenant-fees-act-2019-guidance-for-tenants
